clips.subtitleText: Level 1: He dropped to one knee on the beach and she literally took off running 😭💍
Level 2: Pretended his metal detector found treasure and pulled out the ring 🥹✨
Level 3: News reporter rushed to cover a breaking story and found her boyfriend proposing 🎤💍
Level 4: Faked a basketball injury so she'd run onto the court for the surprise 🏀❤️
Level 5: The exact second she realized what the note actually said 😭💍
